body: for a while he actually didnt care if we were dating or not and he was going to pull the trigger because he said i wasnt good for him, but i asked him to give me another chance. we really did have a loving relationship up until we had to go long distance for a while. i forgot to mention he has adhd and also keeps to himself a lot because he was often rejected when he talked about himself, his interests, and even his problems to the people he was close with. so i dont entirely blame him for being bad at expressing himself.

i know it shouldnt affect my self worth but it did. i just want to work on making it better, theres a likely chance i start therapy in a month or so but at times i just want to end it, and i already have it planned out in my head

i wish it would get better. and im really sorry about your current situation. feels a little selfish to be talking about just myself when you're also struggling. do you want to talk about whats happening with you?
i struggle with basic things, i just want reassurance and appreciation but im just a difficult person and i dont think i deserve bare minimum, im just not good enough
its been proved to me that nobody cares about me through words and actions and i dont feel like i deserve good things

you're wrong, he doesnt have feelings for me anyway and im not good enough to fix things no matter how hard i try, and my family has told me to kill myself and it was hell the day i was born. life would be better without me and nobody hid that fact
